result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and pedestrian signals, providing basic crossing infrastructure in a commercial setting. However, the environment lacks physical protection such as curb extensions or refuge islands, and utility poles on the sidewalk may hinder accessibility.

hazards.name: Utility pole on sidewalk
hazards.description: A utility pole is situated on the corner sidewalk, which may restrict movement for pedestrians using mobility aids.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility by extending the sidewalk at the corners.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting trees along the sidewalk would provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

result.summary: The environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway with industrial land use and minimal pedestrian protection. While a marked crosswalk exists for a side street, the main thoroughfare lacks clear pedestrian crossings, exposing walkers to traffic over long distances.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island or marked crossing on the main thoroughfare.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Railway Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway create tripping hazards and uneven surfaces for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the side-street crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style markings across all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the main road to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway with at-grade railroad tracks and a lack of marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks are present, the environment is dominated by vehicle traffic and industrial land use, offering minimal protection for pedestrians.
